title: job
description: One job found by an agent on a browser source, dropped into <profile>/data/inbox/ for scan.py to import.

job_id.description: the site's own id for the posting (from its URL)

posted.description: YYYY-MM-DD; convert "3 days ago" using today's date; empty if unknown

description.description: full description text as shown, no summarising

experience.description: experience range as the site shows it, e.g. "2-5 Yrs"
